{"people":[{"name":"Jordan","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Halima","role":"COO, final decider","side":"customer"},{"name":"Ben","role":"CTO, our champion","side":"customer"},{"name":"CEO (unnamed)","role":"CEO","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed solutions engineer","role":"Named solutions engineer on competitor's team","side":"competitor"},{"name":"Unnamed account lead","role":"Account lead on competitor's team","side":"competitor"},{"name":"Our solutions engineer (unnamed)","role":"Solutions engineer","side":"us"}],
 "competitors":["Unnamed competitor (winner; name never given in transcript)"],
 "incumbent":"Their existing payments provider (unnamed), whose support was a ticket form",
 "evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"tickets went live at 10am on a Friday, and payments started failing about four minutes in","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Concrete triggering incident; 'minute four' recurs later in customer's ask."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their provider's support was a ticket form. They got a reply after the on-sale was over.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The pain was support responsiveness, not only payment failure."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The CEO was getting screenshots on social.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Executive visibility escalated the issue."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"So Monday morning the COO, Halima, says they're replacing payments before the spring on-sales.","label":"fact","speaker":"Halima (COO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"COO drove the evaluation from the start; deadline is spring on-sales."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Ben, their CTO, said twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Prior on-sale failures had happened before."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"But this was the first time the CEO saw it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger was executive visibility, not first failure."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Ben wanted us. He told me that, and he told me he lost.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Champion favoured us but lacked final authority."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"He called me before the official email went out","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Loss confirmed by an official email."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ben (CTO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Customer confirms Halima as sole decider; decided quickly."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"They showed up with the people who'd actually be on the account. A named solutions engineer and an account lead, in the room.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor sold named people, which matched the customer's 'who' framing."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"they said there'd be a shared channel and someone on call for every major on-sale. That's from Ben.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor promised on-sale coverage directly."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"I think they over-promised. I don't think anybody staffs every on-sale. But I don't know that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's unverified guess, admitted as such."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Everything turned into \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Observed shift in customer questions after competitor meeting."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Who do I call at 10 on a Friday. Who's my person. What's the escalation path if that person's on holiday.","label":"fact","speaker":"customer, relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Customer questions shifted to people and escalation; rep summary, not in quotation marks."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Before that meeting it was throughput, queueing, bots. After, it was names.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Before/after change in evaluation criteria."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"Ben's team ran a load test in the sandbox and it went great.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Technical proof landed with the CTO's team."},
{"id":"E17","turn":12,"excerpt":"The uptime history, the docs. The bot and fraud tooling got a good reaction too.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's characterisation of the reaction; unclear who reacted."},
{"id":"E18","turn":12,"excerpt":"who's my person","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Decider's core question, framed as a person."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"I walked her through the support plans. The tiers, the response times.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Our answer to 'who' was tiers and SLAs."},
{"id":"E20","turn":12,"excerpt":"so it's a queue with a faster timer.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided","language"],"note":"Decider rejected our support framing; rep marks this as the losing moment."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before it we were the favourite.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's read, likely based on champion, not decider."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"Ben had basically told his team to start planning the integration.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"Hedged ('basically'); signal came from the champion, not the decider."},
{"id":"E23","turn":16,"excerpt":"She wanted to see, on paper, what we do on an on-sale morning. Who's watching, who she calls, what happens at minute four.","label":"fact","speaker":"Halima (COO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Specific unmet ask: a written on-sale plan."},
{"id":"E24","turn":16,"excerpt":"We don't have that as a thing. I could have built something with our solutions engineer, and I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Product/packaging gap plus rep's admitted miss."},
{"id":"E25","turn":18,"excerpt":"I thought the load test had won it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep misjudged the buying criterion."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"And a ticketing reference.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep names a missing reference; unclear whether the customer asked for it."},
{"id":"E27","turn":18,"excerpt":"I had logos. I didn't have a person.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Proof gap mirrors the customer's 'who' framing."},
{"id":"E28","turn":20,"excerpt":"Ben presented them to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Decider saw technical proof."},
{"id":"E29","turn":20,"excerpt":"good","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Minimal reaction; technical proof did not move the decider."},
{"id":"E30","turn":22,"excerpt":"A name, not a queue.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not specified)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's framing of the problem."},
{"id":"E31","turn":22,"excerpt":"On-sale morning","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not specified)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's recurring unit of risk."},
{"id":"E32","turn":22,"excerpt":"Someone who picks up.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not specified)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Contrasts with the incumbent's ticket form."},
{"id":"E33","turn":22,"excerpt":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decided"],"note":"Decider explicitly discounts our uptime message."},
{"id":"E34","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody said \"support.\" They said \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer vocabulary differs from ours."},
{"id":"E35","turn":24,"excerpt":"We were the better platform. Ben would tell you that today.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's claim; the platform was not the decider's criterion."}
],
 "contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E21","E22","E9","E4"],"what":"Rep says we were the favourite based on Ben's signals, but Halima drove the evaluation from day one and made the call alone."},
{"evidence":["E25","E16","E29","E33"],"what":"Rep thought the load test had won it, but the decider responded only 'good' and said she doesn't buy uptime."},
{"evidence":["E35","E7","E20"],"what":"Rep claims we were the better platform, yet we lost on support/people, not platform."},
{"evidence":["E19","E18","E23","E24"],"what":"Rep answered 'who's my person' with support tiers, while admitting we had no on-sale plan to show."}
],
 "dodges":[
{"question":"Why not? (why no on-sale plan was built)","turn":17,"what":"Rep blames over-reliance on the load test, then shifts to a missing reference rather than explaining the plan decision."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":23,"what":"Rep asserts we were the better platform, which is unsupported and sidesteps the loss reason."}
],
 "skipped":[],
 "language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"A name, not a queue / who's my person","ours":"support plans, tiers, response times","evidence":["E30","E18","E19"]},
{"theirs":"who","ours":"support","evidence":["E34"]},
{"theirs":"I buy what happens when it's down","ours":"uptime history","evidence":["E33","E17"]},
{"theirs":"On-sale morning / what happens at minute four","ours":"load test, throughput","evidence":["E31","E23","E16"]},
{"theirs":"Someone who picks up","ours":"response times","evidence":["E32","E19"]},
{"theirs":"a person (a reference who picked up)","ours":"logos","evidence":["E27"]}
],
 "outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E8","E9"],"what":"Lost: Ben told the rep he lost before the official email; Halima decided in one meeting."},
{"evidence":["E10","E11"],"what":"The competitor won by offering named people and on-call coverage for on-sales."},
{"evidence":["E4"],"what":"The whole payments provider was being replaced; no sign that only part of the business moved."}
]}
